title: What we learned from benchmarking agents—and then optimizing the experts
lede: Validity, generated-artifact efficiency, and expert co-optimization are different axes. This report keeps them separate, then connects every headline to its public evidence.

outcomes.label: official final reward
outcomes.detail: A complete valid row under a hybrid solving protocol. Solver tokens, cost, and wall time are not comparable with the in-container Harbor runs.

outcomes.label: high → ultra
outcomes.detail: Ultra preserved every High pass and added Task 08. The final 11/12 includes the documented post-hoc Task 07 adjudication.

outcomes.label: descriptive geometric mean
outcomes.detail: Across ten ordinary supported campaigns. Task 07's design reduction and Task 08's feasibility result are intentionally excluded.

evidence_axes.title: Validity
evidence_axes.question: Did the artifact solve the intended task?

evidence_axes.title: Agent artifact efficiency
evidence_axes.question: How slow is a valid generated artifact versus its same-run expert?

evidence_axes.title: Expert co-optimization
evidence_axes.question: How much faster is the optimized expert-derived implementation?

findings.title: Change the exact representation first
findings.body: The largest ordinary gains came from shrinking the exact state, observable, or causal cone before contraction—not from blanket rules about fusion or scans.

findings.title: Visible correctness is not semantic correctness
findings.body: Both GPT-5.6 efforts passed functional and static checks on all twelve tasks, yet final validity was 10/12 and 11/12 after semantic review.

findings.title: Semantic audits also need evidence
findings.body: High Task 05 and Ultra Task 07 were false negatives. Both corrections preserve the original audits and add package- or source-level proof.

findings.title: Task 07 exposes a real loophole
findings.body: The 45.758× candidate passes the executable contract by eliminating the measured register. The conservative full-register alternative still reaches 4.479×.

findings.title: Allocation is part of the result
findings.body: Task 08's expert failed in 7 GiB, not in principle. A 64-GiB run made both implementations pass but did not establish a runtime gain.

findings.title: The harness required auditing too
findings.body: The reward implementation and documented policy were synchronized, and the TensorCircuit nightly pin was updated so all public experts could run unchanged.
